race.description: Taylors Palace Hotel After The Last Hcp (56)
race.comment: THOUGHTFUL (4) raced on the speed and dug deep to score by a neck at today's track and distance last start to maintain his good form of late. Finds another suitable race and can do it again. Among the beaten brigade was DUSTY'S DEEL (8), who was third and only one length from THOUGHTFUL. Was first-up at 1600m that day, so expect him to take great improvement from it. HYDROGEN POWER (5) is another who hits this race second-up, having resumed with a solid effort over 1400m, and he has a couple of second-up placings to his name. SOLAR MIST (2) comes off a couple of fourth placings, the first of them in the race won by THOUGHTFUL. Only beaten 2-1/4 lengths that day but does have a tricky draw here. SURFY PETE (3) is hard to come into off last start but will be better for the two runs back and draws well with Meech aboard, which are plusses.
